== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}
{{Heritage Sticker|ancestors=Native American}}

Isaac Glasko was born on November 16, 1813, and died on August 25, 1877.  He is the son of [[Glasko-4 | Isaac C. Glasko]] and [[Brayton-597 | Lucy Brayton]].

He was a blacksmith in Sprague, Connecticut.

Isaac, son of Isaac Glasko, was born on 16 November 1813 in Griswold, New London, Connecticut, United States.<ref>
'''Birth''':
"Connecticut, Births and Christenings, 1649-1906"<br/>
citing FHL microfilm: 2917<br/>
{{FamilySearch Record|F74M-K8V}} (accessed 8 February 2026)<br/>
Isaac Moodey Glasko born on 16 Nov 1813, son of Isaac Glasko, in Griswold, New London, Connecticut, United States.
</ref>  He had  Native American and African American Heritage. <ref>[https://www.google.com/books/edition/After_King_Philip_s_War/LXrgK29zl2QC?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Isaac+Glasko&pg=PT344&printsec=frontcover After King Philip's War: Presence and Persistence in Indian New England edited by Colin G. Calloway]</ref>

He married Mary Unknown
Children:
# [[Glasko-9|Lucy Glasko (1847-)]]
# Charles 1848
# [[Glasko-11|William Glasko (abt.1850-1870)]]
# George 1852
# Ellen 1856
# [[Glasko-22|James A Glasko (1860-)]]
# Walter 1866

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasko-4]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The retained Connecticut birth entry identifies Isaac as son of Isaac Glasko. Isaac Moodey’s distinctive name, exact 1813 date and known Isaac C/Lucy Brayton family identify that child with the selected household, supporting the father directly.

Recorded 1813 child and Glasko household; the birth-index clause alone is not used to assign the mother.

Next useful test: Check the original entry’s date and any maternal field.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasko-3 Birth: "Connecticut, Births and Christenings, 1649-1906"  citing FHL microfilm: 2917   (accessed 8 February 2026)  Isaac Moodey Glasko born on 16 Nov 1813, son of Isaac Glasko, in Griswold, New London, Connecticut, United States.]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.
